get.description: Online current organization history under exact read.all; rechecked every page. Inclusive explicit observation dates; default30/max100. Descending immutable (created_at,id) keyset; limit+1 rows, actual UTF8 page at most 2MiB and details at most512KiB. Closed canonical base64url JSON cursor binds verified account/org/read.all/dates/limit; untrusted navigation, no HMAC or authority. Own cursors incompatible; SQL independently enforces organization and dates. Byte-limited pages continue after last included row. No cross-page snapshot, deletion inference, offline observation, expiry, lease or edit authority. Unknown/duplicate query and nonempty body refused; all responses private/no-store.

Current exact configured-organization read.all with verified account, durable actor, membership and organization resource scope before checkout. Preserves original owner, definition and provenance; no active-child or assignment requirement. No query selectors or nonempty body, offline observation, write acknowledgement or all-edit authority. Maximum actual UTF8 detail 512KiB.

Current exact configured-organization read.all with verified account, durable actor, membership and matching organization resource scope before checkout. Returns the unchanged bounded audit page and a closed actor_display union. After the business transaction and connection are released, Identity receives only the sorted distinct owner, creator, modifier, included executor and non-null initiator IDs selected by that authorized page. Loaded labels preserve explicit per-ID unavailable results; invalid or unavailable Identity produces temporarily_unavailable for the entire label batch. A fresh final matching account/actor/membership/permission/organization-scope authorization is required before any aggregate publication, including label degradation. One original ten-second monotonic Budget covers input, read, lookup, final authority, owned unwind and serialization. Actual UTF8 limits: audit subtree64KiB, successful Identity input256KiB, error input1KiB and aggregate321KiB; no trimming, partial label batches or pagination changes. Numeric revision DESC keyset, default30/max100; closed canonical cursor binds account/org/capture/read.all/limit/last revision and supplies no authority. Current retained names are not event-time snapshots and grant no authority. No answers, definitions, receipts, account associations or offline observation. Unknown/duplicate query, nonempty body and browser service credentials refused. All responses private/no-store.
